stories.title: The Truth about GET and HTTP Standards, (Tue, Sep 22nd)
stories.description: On Friday, Xavier talked about the newly introduced HTTP Query method. This new method was introduced to allow "GET" requests that include a body. The main reason for this was that GET requests typically do not contain a body. But what if they do?
